exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to cease, to quit
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расста́ться — to part, to separate; перестава́ть — to stop, to cease, to quit; приста́ть — to stick, to adhere; наста́ть — to come, to begin (of time).
**перестаю** — перестава́ть (imperfective): to stop, to cease, to quit. Wiktionary: переста́ть + -ва́ть.
